# Exact-version dependency lock for the Digital Twin AI Assistant.
#
# Generated by installing into a CLEAN, project-only venv — not frozen
# from a shared/global Python install. That distinction is the whole
# point: this project's global dev environment turned out to have
# Django, Flask, mysql-connector, a Jupyter stack, and an unrelated
# project's package installed alongside it. Freezing that would have
# committed garbage as if it were this project's dependency set — which
# is exactly the kind of silent cross-contamination a lockfile exists to
# prevent (see THREAT_MODEL.md §4.10).
#
# Scope: core + [encryption, keyring, voice, tts] + [dev]. (The old
# [gesture] extra is gone: hand tracking runs in the Airboard browser
# page, so mediapipe/opencv and their deps are no longer locked.)
# Deliberately EXCLUDES [browser] (playwright — needs a separate ~300MB
# browser binary download via `playwright install chromium`, orthogonal
# to Python packages) and [semantic] (sentence-transformers — pulls in
# the full torch/transformers stack; not used by this project's default
# config). Regenerate a fuller lock if either of those is actually
# adopted, rather than assuming this file covers them.
#
# Regenerate with a fresh venv, not the one you've been developing in:
#
#   python -m venv .venv_lock
#   .venv_lock\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install --upgrade pip
#   .venv_lock\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install ".[encryption,keyring,voice,tts,dev]"
#   .venv_lock\Scripts\python.exe -m pip freeze --exclude digital-twin-assistant > requirements-lock.txt
#   Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .venv_lock
#
# Install from this lock directly with:
#   pip install -r requirements-lock.txt -e .
#
# One thing this lock caught: mediapipe>=1.0 hard-requires
# opencv-contrib-python, and pyproject.toml used to *also* declare
# opencv-python — installing both means two packages providing the same
# `cv2` import, the exact class of conflict M18 Phase 1 fixed for
# opencv-python-headless. Fixed here by declaring opencv-contrib-python
# instead of opencv-python in the gesture extra (see pyproject.toml).
